caption:
This comma costs people points.

Never put a single comma between a subject and its verb. A pair of commas around extra info is fine.

Follow @samsonsatprep for daily SAT tips.
tiktok_caption: One comma between a subject and its verb? Cut it.

youtube.title: SAT Comma Rule: Never Between Subject and Verb
